import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot with brand colors
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
brands = df['brand'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(brands))
brand_color_map = dict(zip(brands, colors))
for brand in brands:
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, color=brand_color_map[brand])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], 
                      c=df['megapixels'], s=150, alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis')
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price vs Weight (color=Megapixels)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Megapixels')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Model Year distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.bar(df['brand'], df['model_year'], color=sns.color_palette('Set2', len(df)), alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Model Year by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Sensor Type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Max ISO comparison
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bars = ax5.barh(df['brand'], df['max_iso'], color=sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(df)), alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Max ISO Capability by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 6. Body Type distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax6.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('muted', len(body_counts)), alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Heatmap of numerical features
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
numerical_features = df[['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']].copy()
numerical_features['max_iso'] = numerical_features['max_iso'] / 1000
numerical_features['weight_grams'] = numerical_features['weight_grams'] / 100
numerical_features.columns = ['Megapixels', 'Max ISO (x1000)', 'Weight (x100g)', 'Price (USD)']
correlation = numerical_features.corr()
sns.heatmap(correlation, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax7, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax7.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Features', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
